title: A round-up of round-ups of Black Friday deals
content:
The independent education community are really coming together this year to give each other a foot-up. It's in response to the bad times we've gone through and we've ended up becoming a nice, tight community.

We're all determined to push on in 2027 and give you, the readers, the good stuff as we navigate more and more change in our industry. The tighter the industry community is, the better for everyone. Us independent educators and publishers won't stop and will try to be at the centre of that.

Traditionally, we've done a round up of Black Friday deals on Black Friday itself here, but this year, we're mixing it up a bit. We're rounding up the other round-ups. The hope is to give as many as possible a signal boost at what is the most important time of year.

If you can, support independents so we can all move into 2027 with a boost. We all win then 💛

CSS-Tricks

Our very good friends over at CSS-Tricks have compiled a big collection of courses and resources, broken down by discipline for you to browse through. They have also released a new book that's on sale too!

Sara Soueidan

Sara's list is focused on front-end, design systems and accessibility, which is very handy for those looking for a more filtered collection.

Brad Frost

Brad has an important message about community too in his round-up, followed by a vast array of independent educator's course sales.

Baldur Bjarnason

I like the intro to Baldur's list. He's covered a lot of the grim, but there's a lot to be hopeful for too!

Special mentions

We just want to link out to a couple of deals that you might have missed too:

  1. PolyPane (our favourite development browser) has a great, up to 25% discount running
  2. You can get Every Layout for half price
  3. Declan created a handy thread of deals on Bluesky

Check it out!
author: Andy Bell
